interests: LLM post-training and fine-tuning as a company would apply it: (1) training-data selection, curation, mixing and filtering for SFT/preference tuning; (2) data transformation: rewriting/self-distilling targets, synthetic data generation, counterfactual or contrastive pairs, how data format affects generalization and forgetting; (3) data and internal representations: probing, steering vectors, activation-based routing/gating of adapters, representation fine-tuning, why narrow fine-tuning causes broad behavior changes (emergent misalignment, persona features); (4) targeted behavior correction with minimal side effects: refusal/over-refusal calibration, safety preservation during fine-tuning, political bias/censorship, LoRA editing, model editing; (5) LLM-as-judge evaluation of these. Less interested in: pure pretraining scaling, vision-only, robotics, RL for math/code agents unless about data.
